activities.title: Java Program Anatomy
activities.instruction: Explore the parts of a basic Java program.

content.concept: A Java program is organized around classes and methods. Execution of a standard standalone application begins from the main method.

activities.title: Java Execution Flow
activities.instruction: Arrange the stages from Java source code to program execution.

content.concept: Java source code is compiled by the Java compiler into bytecode. The Java Virtual Machine then loads and executes that bytecode.

activities.title: Data Type Matcher
activities.instruction: Choose the most suitable Java type for each value.

content.concept: Java primitive types represent different kinds of values. For example, int stores whole numbers, double stores decimal values, char stores a single character, and boolean stores true or false.
